text:
lia: quick heads-up — proposal to introduce an opt-in header `x-rw-route-policy-v2` that carries minimal structured routing policy (policy_id, priority, quota_key). goal: 1) better quota attribution in console dashboards, 2) deterministic routing for dedicated/private when present, 3) cleaner telemetry mapping. planning canary + SDK helpers. thoughts?
sanjay (eng-platform): :eyes: can you share the exact payload schema? we need to validate for proxy layer and ensure size < 1k. also any plan for backward compatibility?
lia: schema is tiny, e.g. `policy_id=pp-123;pri=10;qk=team:payments` or base64 json for future keys. default: SDKs should send the simple `key=value` semicolon format. fallback: if header missing, platform uses existing heuristics.
marta (devex): UX note — console will need a per-policy breakdown tile. if we change attribution mapping mid-rollout dashboards could show spikes. recommend a staged opt-in where policy_id starts showing as "experimental" tag.
olga (obs): agree. also we need clear telemetry mapping: add a stable metric `requests.attributed_by_policy_v2` and keep existing `requests.attributed` until deprecate. sampling: telemetry agent should tag spans with `rw.policy.v2=true|false`.
kevin (eng-runtime): runtime concerns: routing by policy_id is fine but when policy includes `quota_key` we might route to tenant-affine shards. need to ensure KV cache / batching still works. if SDKs start multicasting policy header, we risk increased tail latency if affinity mismatches.
sophie (py-sdk): from SDK POV we can add `route_policy` arg to clients and small helper to build header. example:```python
# python sdk usage
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
client.generate(prompt, route_policy={'policy_id':'pp-123','pri':10,'quota_key':'team:payments'})
```we'll default off; toggled by feature flag for rollout.
trent (go-maintainer): go SDK will need an API change because our request struct is typed. prefer adding `WithRoutePolicy()` functional option rather than changing method signatures. also watch for vendored libs that parse headers — keep it raw string.
sanjay (eng-platform): rollout plan attempt: week1 - SDKs add helper but off by default + doc; week2 - enable 1% canary via console flag for select tenants; week3 - expand to 10% after 48h stable; week5 - opt-in window ends, evaluate deprecation of old attribution. ok?
marta (devex): please include docs snippets for TS and Go too. we should surface migration checklist in console for early adopter teams.
kevin (eng-runtime): also require a graceful fallback in the runtime: if header malformatted -> log once per minute and continue using heuristics. do not 5xx.
olga (obs): telemetry tasks: 1) add metric `policy_v2_header_parsing_failures` 2) tag `policy_v2_present` on request traces 3) dashboard tile comparing attributed vs legacy attribution. can we get sample logs?
lia: sample header examples: `x-rw-route-policy-v2: policy_id=pp-123;pri=10;quota_key=team:payments` or compact json base64 for extended: `eyJwIjoi...` we'll publish both.
sophie (py-sdk): quick question — do we prefer snake_case or kebab in keys? I'd vote kebab or hyphen-free to avoid header parsing issues.
trent (go-maintainer): keep keys alphanumeric + underscore, no spaces. e.g., `policy_id, priority, quota_key`.
kevin (eng-runtime): one more: if quota_key triggers tenant isolation we need a dry-run mode where we only compute but not enforce routing. add a `rw-route-policy-dryrun=true` flag in platform for the canary.
sanjay (eng-platform): will add dry-run. ops: can we have a canary config like `canary_rules: [{percent:1, match: header exists}]` in console?
marta (devex): yes — console product will add a single-line boolean toggle for early access teams and an analytics link.
dev-bot: deployed canary config to staging: canary 1% header-dryrun=true — results should land in staging telemetry.
olga (obs): I'll watch staging dashboards. please add `rw.policy.request_id` into trace logs for easier joins.
sophie (py-sdk): timeline for SDK release? i can cut a minor release with helper + docs by EOW if we freeze schema today.
lia: sounds good. freeze schema now. action items: sophie/trent add helper + docs, sanjay enable dry-run + canary config, olga add metrics & dashboards, kevin add parsing safe-fail + logging. we'll reconvene after staging 48h. thanks all :thumbsup:
